title: 第4章 力武境！
content_zh:
突破来的如此迅速，却未曾令秦政感到多少的震惊，因为这是厚积薄发的效果，他的血脉洗练太多次了，三百次的成功与失败，不断地磨砺，不但磨砺了他的心，更是令其积压了太久，如今终于有九色神莲化为武脉，令他解除桎梏，突破也是理所当然的，甚至有可能在天武境这一公认的自我蜕变的境界前，都会以超出常人想象的速度突破。

秦政兴奋地握紧拳头，六年的修炼，不断地失败，饶是他那颗饱经磨砺的心也颤抖了，一朝成功，便是秦政也控制不住泪水流了下来。

但是他明白，必须隐秘，绝对不能让别人知道。

九色神莲经乃是神武大陆三大武经之一，是能够打破人神桎梏的武经，早就失传不知多少岁月，也是如此，距离有记载的最后一次有人立地成神，已经有五千年之久了，五千年来，无人成神，一旦被人知晓九色神莲经的所在，势必要引起神武大陆所有人的注意。

若是这般，他就真的危险了，甚至东海王府，连带着大炎帝国都可能面临着灭顶之灾。

必须要隐藏修炼九色神莲经的事情。

秦政冷静之后，来到外面，查看一番，并没有什么人，可以确定，之前修炼应该没有引起什么人的注意，这也不奇怪，玉莲院位于东海王府最后面的院子内，是独立的一个院子，也是老东海王不愿意让人来打扰，所以这里比较僻静。

这一番修炼，花费了十多个小时时间，秦政也是饿了，随便吃了点东西，期间他的脑海中还盘旋着一个念头，“我可以修炼，那就更表明我的血非凡了，不知这血脉有什么样的奥妙。”

这念头暂时被秦政压在心底，他目前要做的是修炼。

九色神莲武脉成型，接下来的修炼就不再是单纯的感应天地精气了，达到力武境，力气大增，秦政也颇想看看自己的变化。

他来到那雕刻着玉莲花池四个字的石碑前。

此石碑露在外面的地方高有三米，厚达一米，重量自然是十分惊人的，以前秦政曾经无聊试着去撼动这石碑，结果是纹丝不动。

他半蹲下身，探手抱住石碑两面，猛然发力。

全身的肌肉都鼓起来了，就听那石碑发出咯吱的响声，好似被其力量给勒的要裂开似得，然后他缓缓站直身躯，就见那石碑慢慢的往上移动，埋入地面的部分开始显现出来，等他站直了，石碑还有很大一部分埋在地下。

“这力量大了何止一两倍，足有十倍啊。”

“力武境果然是远胜过肉身境界。”

秦政后退两步，打量石碑，然后便再次上前。

再度拔高之后，隐约可见石碑快要完全暴露出来了，秦政便再次用力往下压，将石碑重新压落地下，回归原来的模样儿。

如此往复数次，他便清楚了力武境的力气之大。

兴奋之余，秦政也是毫无睡意，便到了玉莲院的后院修炼场所。

力武境也只是武道的基础，是改变一个人身体的过程，唯有突破力武境达到气武境，才能够引动天地精气不断地熔炼进入武脉，进行真正的武道修炼。

故而现在还是不断地磨练身体的过程。

秦政在双腿，双臂都捆绑上铁块，后背还背着一根足有两米多长，粗有半米的铁棍，如此便开始在修炼场内纵跃。

他下蹲到极限，然后猛然纵跃起来。

人在空中，那铁块重量就令他感到有些难以承受，而背后的铁棍更是让他失去了平衡，一下子摔在地上。

铁棍也压在身上，疼的秦政发出低声惨叫。

铁棍就是用来平衡的，让秦政随时随地都能保持平衡，他清晰的记得一句话，那就是老东海王在弥留时期自言自语过，“平衡是武道，人道，天道的最根本。”

咬着牙，秦政再次爬起来，继续弹跳。

这次可好，那铁棍直接脱手，差点砸在他的身上。

一夜过去，东方鱼肚白，秦政还在修炼。

他的内心深处，始终有着强烈的危机感，那就是九色神莲经。

目前无人知道他修炼九色神莲经，那不代表着不会暴露，一旦暴露，以九色神莲经对武者的诱惑力，如果不能有威慑神武大陆的实力，就只有死。

若是曾经他还会单纯的认为，这个世界上秘密可以保守的，现在很难了，那老东海王留下的铁盒子就是证明，终究会被发现。

故而这种紧迫感，令他修炼的非常疯狂。

当完成修炼，秦政便催动九色神莲，疲惫感，修炼带来的小伤刹那间恢复如初。

其一，可疗伤，小伤小痛疲劳轻松去除，当修炼到极致，甚至可达不死地步。

其二，可提升战斗力，达到气武境之后，九色神莲武脉会孕育神莲之力，能够令战力倍增。

其三，达气武境之后，每一个大境界，都会洗练血脉精华，凝聚一滴神莲血，这一滴神莲血能够助一个人的武脉蜕变或者完善，是所有武者都想要得到的，可以说修炼九色神莲经的人，那就是别人眼里的无上至宝。

伤痛尽去，秦政洗了个澡，吃过早饭，他便离开王府，再次来到燕听雨所在的帝都一角偏僻小院落内。

这次来的时候，燕听雨正在磨练自己的炼兵术，见到秦政到来，也是颇感吃惊。

“我突破了！”秦政在她面前一站。

“昨天才完成第三百次突破，今天就又一次突破？你当我主攻炼兵师，不是武者啊。”燕听雨完全不信。

秦政一笑，探手抓住那炼兵炉，只用右手的拇指，食指和中指，三指捏住炼兵炉，轻轻一提，就见那炼兵炉一下子便脱离地面，悬空了。

燕听雨捂住嘴巴，惊骇道：“力武境！”

“不可思议，你怎么突破的，你没有武脉，如何能够突破，而且一夜之间，成就力武境，这不可能。”燕听雨难以置信的道。

“你怎么做到的……”燕听雨张口便询问，随即眨眨眼，道，“你没追问过我为何有如此精湛的炼兵术，那我就不问你如何突破的了。”

秦政就知道燕听雨一定不会追问的，这是一种默契，“我来是告诉你，如果有人向你打听我如何能够突破的，就说我有隐藏的武脉。”

他这么做，也是尽可能的掩藏自己修炼九色神莲经的事情，尽量不留下一丝破绽。

“看来你突破这事，隐藏着很大的秘密哦。”燕听雨笑道。

“嗯，很大的秘密，以后我会告诉你的。”秦政一脸的严肃。

见到秦政这般严肃的样子，燕听雨也收敛笑容，沉吟道：“放心吧，我是不会将你的事情告诉任何人的。”她亲自查验秦政的境界，确定之后，这才说道：“你对我提升炼兵术也是有着很大帮助的，我也该感谢感谢你了，这样吧，我为你打造一件兵器，另外赠送给你一种神奇武技。”

秦政大感兴趣，“我记得你曾经说过为我设计过一件兵器，就等我达到力武境，便为我打造，是什么兵器？”

“非刀非剑非枪非戟，具体是什么，给我二十天的时间来炼制，到时候你来取自然知晓了。”燕听雨卖了个关子。

“好吧，那这神奇武技呢。”秦政心知这丫头一旦不想说，任何人都休想让她吐出秘密，这是秦政信任她的原因，就好像燕听雨信任他一样。

燕听雨将两个卷轴交给秦政，“你回去修炼吧，我也要为你炼制一件趁手兵器了。”

也没让秦政在这里观看，就将他赶走了。

燕听雨迫不及待的要炼制一件她有生以来最得意的作品。

秦政也没多逗留，就这么来匆匆，去匆匆的重回王府。

此卷轴中记载着一种武技，名曰斗虎势！

斗虎势是神奇的武技，上面记载的只是如何发力运用，但是如何将其施展的力量更加威猛，却需要根据虎类妖兽展现出来的那种纯粹兽性本能的举动来感悟，故而有人掌握斗虎势，能够越级挑战；有人掌握斗虎势甚至面对低于自身实力的人也是败北。

打开另外一个卷轴，赫然是一副百虎图。

内里每一只虎类妖兽都被描绘的栩栩如生，而且是这虎类妖兽最癫狂的时候，一眼看去，就如同呈现在近前一样。

观百虎可小成；观千虎可大成；观万虎可圆满；观尽神武大陆一切虎类妖兽癫狂之态可达大圆满！

秦政在熟读斗虎势运用发力之法后，便观看百虎图，修炼斗虎势。
content_en:
The breakthrough came so quickly, but it did not shock Qin Zheng much, because it was the effect of accumulation. His bloodline had been refined too many times. Three hundred times of success and failure, continuous tempering, not only tempered his heart, but also made himAfter being backlogged for too long, now the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus has finally turned into martial arts, freeing him from the shackles. It is natural for him to break through. It is even possible that he will break through at a speed beyond ordinary people's imagination before the Tianwu Realm, a recognized realm of self-transformation.

Qin Zheng clenched his fists in excitement. After six years of practice, he continued to fail, which made his tempered heart tremble. Once he succeeded, even Qin Zheng couldn't control the tears flowing down.

But he understood that it must be kept secret and must not be known to others.

The Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra is one of the three major martial arts scriptures in the Shenwu Continent. It is a martial arts scripture that can break the shackles of humans and gods. It has been lost for countless years. It is also the same. It has been five thousand years since the last time someone became a god on record. For five thousand years, no one has become a god. Once the location of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra is known, it will inevitably attract the attention of everyone in the Shenwu Continent.

If this is the case, he is really in danger, and even the East China Sea Palace and the Great Yan Empire may face annihilation.

It is necessary to hide the matter of practicing the Nine Colors God Lotus Sutra.

After Qin Zheng calmed down, he went outside and checked. There was no one there. It was certain that the previous practice should not have attracted anyone's attention. This was not surprising. Yulian Courtyard was located in the backmost courtyard of the East China Sea Prince's Palace. It was an independent courtyard. The old East China Sea King did not want anyone to disturb him, so it was relatively quiet here.

This practice took more than ten hours. Qin Zheng was also hungry and ate something casually. During this period, a thought was lingering in his mind, "I can practice, which means that my blood is extraordinary. I don't know what kind of mystery this blood has."

This thought was suppressed by Qin Zheng for the time being. What he wanted to do now was practice.

The Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Martial Vein takes shape, and the subsequent training is no longer simply about sensing the essence of heaven and earth. When it reaches the martial arts realm, its strength increases greatly. Qin Zheng also wants to see his own changes.

He came to the stone tablet engraved with the words "Jade Lotus Pond".

The exposed part of this stone tablet is three meters high and one meter thick. The weight is naturally very shocking. Qin Zheng once tried to shake this stone tablet out of boredom, but it didn't move at all.

He squatted down, reached out his hands to hug both sides of the stone tablet, and exerted force suddenly.

All the muscles in his body bulged, and he heard the creaking sound of the stone tablet, as if it was about to crack due to its strength. Then he slowly stood up straight, and saw that the stone tablet slowly moved upwards, and the part buried in the ground began to appear. When he stood up straight, a large part of the stone tablet was still buried in the ground.

"This power is not only twice as powerful, but ten times as powerful."

"The martial arts realm is indeed far better than the physical realm."

Qin Zheng took two steps back, looked at the stone tablet, and then stepped forward again.

After raising it again, it was vaguely visible that the stele was about to be completely exposed. Qin Zheng pressed down again and pushed the stele to the ground again, returning to its original appearance.

After doing this several times, he understood how powerful the Liwu realm was.

Although he was excited, Qin Zheng was not sleepy at all, so he went to the backyard training place of Yulianyuan.

The Liwu realm is only the foundation of martial arts. It is the process of changing a person's body. Only by breaking through the Liwu realm and reaching the Qiwu realm can the essence of heaven and earth be continuously smelted into the martial arts and true martial arts practice can be carried out.

Therefore, it is still a process of constantly training the body.

Qin Zheng's legs and arms were tied with iron blocks, and an iron rod more than two meters long and half a meter thick was carried on his back, and he began to jump around the training ground.

He squatted as low as possible, then jumped up suddenly.

When a person was in the air, the weight of the iron block made him feel a little unbearable, and the iron bar behind him made him lose his balance and fell to the ground.

The iron rod also pressed on his body, and Qin Zheng let out a low scream in pain.

The iron rod is used for balance, allowing Qin Zheng to maintain balance anytime and anywhere. He clearly remembers a sentence that the old King of Donghai said to himself when he was dying, "Balance is the most fundamental of martial arts, humanity, and heaven."

Gritting his teeth, Qin Zheng got up again and continued to bounce.

This time, it was good. The iron rod was released and almost hit him.

One night passed, Dongfang's fish belly turned white, and Qin Zheng was still practicing.

Deep in his heart, he always had a strong sense of crisis, that was the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra.

At present, no one knows that he practices the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra, but that does not mean that he will not be exposed. Once exposed, with the temptation of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra to warriors, if he cannot have the strength to intimidate the Shenwu Continent, he will have no choice but to die.

If he had once simply believed that secrets could be kept in this world, now it is difficult. The iron box left by the old Donghai King is proof that it will eventually be discovered.

Therefore, this sense of urgency made him practice very crazily.

After completing the training, Qin Zheng activated the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus, and the fatigue and minor injuries caused by the training were restored to their original state in an instant.

First, it can heal injuries, and minor injuries, pains, and fatigue can be easily removed. When practiced to the extreme, it can even reach the point of immortality.

Secondly, it can improve combat effectiveness. After reaching the Qi Martial Realm, the nine-color divine lotus martial veins will breed the power of the divine lotus, which can double the combat effectiveness.

Thirdly, after reaching the Qi Martial Realm, each major realm will refine the blood essence and condense a drop of Divine Lotus blood. This drop of Divine Lotus blood can help a person's martial arts transform or improve, which is what all warriors want. It can be said that those who practice the Nine-Color Divine Lotus Sutra are the supreme treasure in the eyes of others.

After the pain was gone, Qin Zheng took a bath and had breakfast. He left the palace and came to the remote small courtyard in a corner of the imperial capital where Yan Tingyu was once again.

When he came this time, Yan Tingyu was honing his weapon refining skills, and was quite surprised to see Qin Zheng arrive.

"I made a breakthrough!" Qin Zheng stood in front of her.

"I only completed my 300th breakthrough yesterday, and yet another breakthrough today? You think I'm the main weapon refiner, not a warrior." Yan Tingyu didn't believe it at all.

Qin Zheng smiled, reached out and grabbed the weapon-refining furnace, using only the thumb, index finger and middle finger of his right hand to hold the weapon-refining furnace. He gently lifted it and saw that the weapon-refining furnace suddenly lifted off the ground and was suspended in the air.

Yan Tingyu covered her mouth and said in horror: "Strong martial arts realm!"

"It's unbelievable. How did you break through? You have no martial arts. How can you break through and achieve the martial arts realm overnight? This is impossible." Yan Tingyu said in disbelief.

"How did you do it..." Yan Tingyu opened her mouth to ask, then blinked and said, "You haven't asked me why I have such superb weapon refining skills, so I won't ask you how to break through."

Qin Zheng knew that Yan Tingyu would not ask further questions. This was a tacit understanding. "I'm here to tell you that if anyone asks you how I was able to break through, just say that I have a hidden martial arts vein."

In doing so, he also tried his best to hide his practice of the Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra and try not to leave any flaws.

"It seems that there is a big secret hidden in your breakthrough." Yan Tingyu said with a smile.

"Well, it's a big secret. I will tell you later." Qin Zheng looked serious.

Seeing Qin Zheng's serious look, Yan Tingyu also suppressed her smile and said to herself: "Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about you." She personally checked Qin Zheng's level. After confirming it, she said: "You have also been of great help to me in improving my weapon refining skills. I should also thank you. How about this? I will build a weapon for you and give you a magical martial skill."

Qin Zheng was very interested, "I remember you once said that you designed a weapon for me, and you would build it for me when I reach the martial arts realm. What weapon is it?"

"It's not a sword, it's not a sword, it's not a spear, it's not a halberd. Give me twenty days to refine it, and you'll know what it is when you come to get it." Yan Tingyu gave up.

"Okay, what about this magical martial arts." Qin Zheng knew that if this girl didn't want to tell, no one would make her reveal the secret. This was the reason why Qin Zheng trusted her, just like Yan Tingyu trusted him.

Yan Tingyu handed the two scrolls to Qin Zheng, "You can go back and practice. I will also refine a handy weapon for you."

Qin Zheng was not allowed to watch here, so he drove him away.

Yan Tingyu couldn't wait to refine the most proud work of her life.

Qin Zheng didn't stay long, he just came and went back to the palace in a hurry.

This scroll records a martial art called Tiger Fighting!

The Tiger Fighting Technique is a miraculous martial skill. What is recorded above is only how to exert force. However, how to exert more powerful force needs to be understood based on the pure animalistic instincts displayed by tiger monsters. Therefore, some people master the Tiger Fighting Technique and can leapfrog challenges; some people master the Tiger Fighting Technique and even lose against people whose strength is lower than their own.

Opening another scroll, there is a picture of hundreds of tigers.

Every tiger monster inside is painted lifelike, and when the tiger monster is at its most crazy, at a glance, it looks like it is right in front of you.

Watching a hundred tigers can bring you a small success; watching a thousand tigers can bring you a great success; watching thousands of tigers can bring you perfection; watching the madness of all the tiger monsters in Shenwu Continent can bring you great perfection!

After Qin Zheng was familiar with the method of exerting force in the tiger fighting posture, he watched the Hundred Tigers Picture and practiced the tiger fighting posture.
